sourceNotes.fixKind: whether the rule's own tests show a fix, a suggestion, or both (examples/<rule>.json)
sourceNotes.language: the registry the row comes from; only the TypeScript registry is exported today
sourceNotes.messageIds: the message ids the rule's own tests assert (examples/<rule>.json)
sourceNotes.name: the rule registry (internal/lint/registry), as `cohere --rules` lists it
sourceNotes.namespace: the registered name, before its last slash
sourceNotes.options: the rule's registration: which decoder it carries and whether it requires options
sourceNotes.origin: the registered namespace, and for a bare name the Go package that registers it
sourceNotes.sets: each carried rule set as the loader resolves it, at warn or error, top-level rules only
sourceNotes.upstreamName: the registered name, for a rule ported from a plugin or ESLint core
